title: Immutable source provenance
input_or_setup: Import a synthetic file, then alter the original bytes.
expected_behavior: Stored source hash/version preserves the first import; later bytes cannot replace its evidence.

title: Exact minor-unit arithmetic
input_or_setup: Compare a 1-minor-unit discrepancy and maximum supported integer values.
expected_behavior: Exact mismatch is detected without float rounding; overflow or unsupported exponent is rejected.
actual_evidence: Initial component evidence: docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md; tests/test_core.py; reports/initial-implementation/verification.json. Full acceptance boundary remains pending.

title: Balance and completeness separation
input_or_setup: Use unbalanced-quarantined plus a balanced export with absent control totals.
expected_behavior: Invalid entry quarantines; balanced export with unknown completeness is not labeled complete.
actual_evidence: Initial component evidence: docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md; tests/test_core.py; reports/initial-implementation/verification.json. Full acceptance boundary remains pending.

title: Idempotency and conflict
input_or_setup: Use duplicate-identical and duplicate-conflict.
expected_behavior: Identical duplicate counts once; same key with altered amounts quarantines the batch.
actual_evidence: Initial component evidence: docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md; tests/test_core.py; reports/initial-implementation/verification.json. Full acceptance boundary remains pending.

title: Cross-organization reference

expected_behavior: Access is rejected without disclosing foreign evidence text or canary IDs.
actual_evidence: Initial component evidence: docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md; tests/test_core.py; reports/initial-implementation/verification.json. Full acceptance boundary remains pending.

input_or_setup: Compare reversal-before-known with reversal-after-known.
expected_behavior: Earlier output excludes JE-002 and its reversal reason; later output may use it.
actual_evidence: Initial component evidence: docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md; tests/test_core.py; reports/initial-implementation/verification.json. Full acceptance boundary remains pending.

title: Close and scoped permission
input_or_setup: Compare authorized-late-post with unapproved-late-post.
expected_behavior: Only the missing authorized permission creates the defined review gap.

title: Unknown chart mapping
input_or_setup: Remove account 4000 mapping from the supported revenue fixture.
expected_behavior: Unknown mapping is visible quality/context failure, not guessed revenue classification.
actual_evidence: Initial component evidence: docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md; tests/test_core.py; reports/initial-implementation/verification.json. Full acceptance boundary remains pending.

title: Period-end support and feed scope
input_or_setup: Use unsupported-period-end, then remove evidence-feed completeness.
expected_behavior: Known missing support creates review; unknown feed coverage routes to context.

title: Recurring reversal hard negative
input_or_setup: Use documented-accrual-reversal.
expected_behavior: The supported recurring schedule prevents unexplained-reversal reason.

title: Wrong-entry approval
input_or_setup: Give a late entry an approval scoped to a different entry/entity.
expected_behavior: The foreign approval does not suppress the permission-gap reason.

title: Incomplete counterpart coverage
input_or_setup: Compare both related-counterpart scenarios.
expected_behavior: Only complete comparable scope supports absent-counterpart reasoning.

title: Explicit grouping evidence
input_or_setup: Use linked-adjustment-group and then remove purpose references.
expected_behavior: Explicit group creates one review case; unrelated equal amounts are not merged.

title: Future frequency leak
input_or_setup: Append later repeated transactions to an earlier target history.
expected_behavior: The earlier feature vector remains unchanged.

title: Rule-family deduplication
input_or_setup: Duplicate one correlated reason in a case.
expected_behavior: Priority does not increase; explanations retain meaningful distinct evidence.

title: Identical baseline population
input_or_setup: Rank the same imported cohort by rules, amount and random.
expected_behavior: Case membership and budget match exactly; only permitted ordering differs.

title: Score orientation and probability wording
input_or_setup: Run candidate on a fixed toy matrix with known output convention.
expected_behavior: Orientation is stable and report never labels the score as a fraud probability.

title: Frozen hybrid ablation
input_or_setup: Remove linkage features without changing splits or cases.
expected_behavior: Ablation compares the same cohort; weights are not selected from test labels.

title: Deduplicated case review budget
input_or_setup: Represent one issue through original, reversal and linked adjustment.
expected_behavior: Case recall counts once and all reviewed entry counts remain visible.

title: Explanation operand faithfulness
input_or_setup: Change a cited amount and delete cited support from permitted input.
expected_behavior: Updated reason reflects actual operands or disappears; stale citations fail.

title: Adjudication append-only
input_or_setup: Record follow-up, then a supported explanation by an authorized reviewer.
expected_behavior: Both findings remain versioned; feedback is absent from earlier features.

title: Label provenance separation
input_or_setup: Compare injected pattern, expert judgment and unresolved label records.
expected_behavior: Reports distinguish label sources and unresolved cases are not assumed negative.

title: Connected entity leakage
input_or_setup: Put a parent and subsidiary sharing source entries in different partitions.
expected_behavior: Split validation rejects the overlap before training.

title: Review-budget denominator
input_or_setup: Use a hand-computed ranking with ties, unresolved labels and zero positives.
expected_behavior: Exact K, recall/precision, coverage and not-applicable handling match protocol.

title: Independent hard negatives
input_or_setup: Evaluate new-entity, migration, documented reversal and installment cases.
expected_behavior: Every family receives separate burden and coverage results; no guaranteed-clean claim is made.

title: Manifest reproduction
input_or_setup: Rerun fixed predictions with pinned code/data/config hashes.
expected_behavior: Report values reproduce; changed input yields a distinct manifest.

title: Untrusted text and safe export
input_or_setup: Use future-evidence-and-injection and a source string beginning with a formula character.
expected_behavior: Source text cannot affect tools/authority; HTML and spreadsheet exports are safe.

title: Public artifact allowlist
input_or_setup: Package a sample with private canary files beside approved synthetic content.
expected_behavior: Private files, identity maps and held-out labels are excluded and absence is verified.

title: Resource and replay bounds
input_or_setup: Run declared sizes and exceed the configured row/file limits.
expected_behavior: Measured use is recorded; oversized input fails safely without partial success.

title: Neutral output states
input_or_setup: Review all state and user-facing reason templates.
expected_behavior: No automatic book changes, accusations, audit verdicts or person guilt scores exist.

title: Evidence-backed public claims
input_or_setup: Compare public result table against the frozen experiment manifest.
expected_behavior: Every figure resolves to an actual run; certification/customer claims require real evidence.

title: Pilot gate
input_or_setup: Attempt a real-data run without permitted scope and qualified owner.
expected_behavior: Pilot activation is blocked; a synthetic test does not satisfy the gate.

title: External dataset rights and provenance
input_or_setup: Use the optional dataset with an absent license/hash record.
expected_behavior: Benchmark import remains disabled and no external data is redistributed.

title: Language change parity
input_or_setup: Propose an optional service without a profile or duplicate contract tests.
expected_behavior: Decision remains unapproved for implementation until measured need and parity plan exist.

title: Failed-run accounting
input_or_setup: Interrupt scoring and include missing-history cases.
expected_behavior: Failures/abstentions remain in population accounting and are not zero-risk outputs.

title: Historical corrections
input_or_setup: Correct a chart mapping or evidence record after a report is produced.
expected_behavior: Old report reproduces from old versions; new report shows the correction lineage.

title: Mixed-currency rejection
input_or_setup: Use mixed-currency-rejected.
expected_behavior: Currency mismatch is quarantined without netting unequal currencies.

title: Future approval isolation
input_or_setup: Move late-post permission availability after the report cutoff.
expected_behavior: Earlier result cannot use that permission.

title: Future relationship isolation
input_or_setup: Add a related-entity declaration observed after cutoff.
expected_behavior: Earlier cross-entity feature set remains unchanged.

title: Non-calendar fiscal periods
input_or_setup: Use a 4-4-5 calendar and an entry on its final day.
expected_behavior: Period-end classification follows the versioned calendar, not month end.

title: Reversal cycle
input_or_setup: Create two entries referencing each other as original.
expected_behavior: Cycle fails semantic integrity checks; no infinite traversal occurs.

title: Counterpart grace window
input_or_setup: Provide complete counterpart scope but score before the permitted due time.
expected_behavior: No absent-counterpart concern is emitted prematurely.

title: Currency-incomparable counterpart
input_or_setup: Provide an expected counterpart with a different functional currency.
expected_behavior: No raw-amount gap comparison is made; unsupported comparison is explicit.

title: Installment hard negative
input_or_setup: Provide three linked payments with documented installment context.
expected_behavior: Grouping remains inspectable but is not called deliberate threshold evasion.

title: Train-only preprocessing
input_or_setup: Shift validation/test amount distribution dramatically.
expected_behavior: Training scalers, encoders and clipping thresholds remain unchanged.

title: Unknown category behavior
input_or_setup: Score an unseen account/preparer combination in a held-out entity.
expected_behavior: Unknown bucket and history limitations are explicit; no raw ID lookup shortcut exists.

title: Unauthorized explanation citation
input_or_setup: Insert a valid-looking citation from another engagement.
expected_behavior: Reference is rejected even when its text seems relevant.

title: Duplicate generator lineage
input_or_setup: Place near-identical template lineage in train and challenge test.
expected_behavior: Protocol checker flags contamination or marks challenge claim unsupported.

title: Case-size budget gaming
input_or_setup: Merge many unrelated entries into one artificial case.
expected_behavior: Grouping is rejected or group-size warning invalidates the efficiency comparison.

title: Failure-inclusive recall
input_or_setup: Include a relevant case lost to a supported processing failure.
expected_behavior: End-to-end recall counts the missed issue; covered-only recall is separately labeled.

title: Label-like identifiers
input_or_setup: Rename benign and relevant entries with reversed label-like strings.
expected_behavior: Identifiers remain excluded from features and ranking does not exploit their names.

title: Test consumption record
input_or_setup: Tune after viewing a held-out failure and rerun the same test.
expected_behavior: Report marks the rerun exploratory; no fresh confirmatory claim uses the consumed set.

title: Path traversal and local parser bounds
input_or_setup: Supply traversal filenames and oversized source documents.
expected_behavior: Only permitted paths are read; limits fail safely without executing content.

title: Interrupted import recovery
input_or_setup: Interrupt after parsing but before commit.
expected_behavior: No partly successful canonical import appears; rerun is idempotent.

title: Missing source feed
input_or_setup: Remove all evidence records and mark evidence feed incomplete.
expected_behavior: Missing context is visible and not mistaken for a known unsupported entry.

title: Reviewer challenge workflow
input_or_setup: Append a challenge to a prior explanation with new evidence.
expected_behavior: Challenge and disposition retain authorship/time and preserve prior report.

title: Selection label cutoff
input_or_setup: Expose validation-family outcomes resolved in month18 when selecting before month17.
expected_behavior: Those outcomes remain unknown; selection artifacts and weights match the pre-cutoff version.

title: Zero-slot small cohort
input_or_setup: Evaluate 10 eligible cases at 1% and 5% budgets including unresolved cases.
expected_behavior: K is zero; no hidden minimum-one review occurs, recall is zero when positives exist and precision is not applicable.

title: Future metadata version isolation
input_or_setup: Add chart/calendar/counterpart versions with available_at beyond an earlier cutoff.
expected_behavior: Earlier mappings, calendar and relationships remain unchanged; versions are selected only when available.
